SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.7
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2882–2972 cm⁻¹ and a CH₂/CH₃ deformation near 1450 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003), plus distinctive bands at ~919 and ~1028 cm⁻¹ that are characteristic of C–O–C stretching in a saturated five-membered cyclic ether. The cluster of ring-related modes at 763–814 cm⁻¹ further supports a tetrahydrofuran-type ring. Among the candidates, OCC1CCCO1 (tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol) uniquely matches a cyclic ether with aliphatic CH features; candidates lacking a ring or bearing N≡N (e.g., 4) are inconsistent with the absence of a ~2300–2400 cm⁻¹ band (GFQ-008).
